cases.payer: UK training provider with prepared slides
cases.trigger: Existing PowerPoint training deck must run and report completion in client LMS
cases.money_evidence: £500 from human enhanced SCORM conversion service; £150 basic auto-tier offered by same supplier
cases.bought_outcome: interactive mobile-safe SCORM 1.2/2004 course, quiz, tracking, verified deployment to chosen LMS
cases.input_output_and_verification: PPT and assessment brief -> working SCORM .zip with LMS test receipts; HTML/ZIP checks deterministic, instructional rework editorial
cases.D: D3 for SCORM packaging; D1 for instructional redesign
cases.repeated_AI: Can generate quiz questions and HTML, not ensure instructional accuracy or LMS-specific tracking with zero QA
cases.AI_built_entry: Automated tier already does the narrow job; £500 tier is explicitly instructional human work
cases.first_ten: UK learning providers with LMS and course backlog; ten specific switchers not verified
cases.strongest_kill: Exact incumbent sells both automatic conversion and enhanced labour; no new independent purchase for an AI wrapper
cases.cheapest_falsification: Revisit only on buyer-paid LMS defect assurance after automated conversion failed at material volume

cases.payer: UK cabinet maker or joinery subcontractor
cases.trigger: Custom kitchen/shopfit joinery enters manufacture and needs signed drawings
cases.money_evidence: £440–£1,250+ per drawing quoted by white-label joinery bureau
cases.bought_outcome: shop drawings with fixing/joint methods, all dimensions and material details, change control and client approval
cases.input_output_and_verification: Approved concept and measurements -> client-approved shop drawings plus factory-specific manufacturing instructions; independent dimensions partly checkable
cases.repeated_AI: Renders basic cabinetry but joinery tolerances, fixings, unsupported interfaces require expert verification
cases.AI_built_entry: Parametric CNC shop software and low-cost bureaux already serve output; creating file generator no advantage
cases.first_ten: Joinery trade associations and local shopfit subcontractors; ten matched buyer signs absent
cases.strongest_kill: Price includes manufacturing interpretation, unlimited revision to client approval, and expert shop responsibility
cases.cheapest_falsification: No CAD file-only product without paid service evidence for exact machine-verified subclass

cases.payer: UK industrial equipment brand launching assembly instructions
cases.trigger: New assembly manual needs exploded technical illustration from existing components
cases.money_evidence: £10 starting per specialist illustration, print-format and unlimited design changes offered
cases.bought_outcome: accurate exploded-view diagrams with part hierarchy, step arrows, fit and readable labels
cases.input_output_and_verification: Part CAD/photographs + BOM -> vector illustrations; raster size checkable; geometry/assembly order may need expert input
cases.repeated_AI: Can stylise drawing but frequently invents part fit and disassembly sequencing
cases.AI_built_entry: CAD composer already supports exploded automation; per-image human service very cheap
cases.first_ten: Independent machinery assembly firms; ten proven repetitive commission buyers not identified
cases.strongest_kill: £10 price and engineering-signoff exception costs cannot support high-ticket independent automation
cases.cheapest_falsification: Do not infer whole manual price from illustration line item

cases.payer: UK survey firm with existing total-station point CSV
cases.trigger: Survey party returns data but office CAD capacity is overloaded
cases.money_evidence: £499–£1,499 for third-party survey-to-topographic Civil 3D surface model
cases.bought_outcome: georeferenced contoured DWG/DXF site plan, breaklines, levels, DTM and QA report
cases.input_output_and_verification: Given labelled coordinates and breakline constraints -> Civil3D deliverable matching survey and tolerance; topo continuity not automatically guaranteed
cases.repeated_AI: AI can classify raw descriptions but cannot recover undrawn linework and resolve instrument-control mismatch without operator
cases.AI_built_entry: Civil 3D import/model and existing offshore white-label bureau cover common workflow
cases.first_ten: RICS geomatics companies, no buyer switch/test verified
cases.strongest_kill: Bought job includes surveyor QC and surface reconstruction; this is distinct from scan-to-BIM (#779) but similar founder QC barrier
cases.cheapest_falsification: Document threshold: obtain representative survey CSV + accepted DWG and independent certified control points; if consistent automated completion >90% and buyers separately pay, re-evaluate

cases.payer: UK installer/homeowner fitting wet underfloor heat system
cases.trigger: Plumbing kit quote requires loop diagram and room-by-room design before installation
cases.money_evidence: £19.99–£70 priority CAD plan from several suppliers; £35 deposit refundable on purchase
cases.bought_outcome: accurate pipe loop heat loss, manifold zones and manufacturer-material quote in 24–48h
cases.input_output_and_verification: Floor plan dimensions/materials -> PDF/DWG pipe plans and parts quote; topology calculable, heat loss depends on site fabric facts
cases.repeated_AI: May draft layouts but heat-loss engineering and correct parts require manufacturer constraints
cases.AI_built_entry: Supplier product ecosystem treats design as sales acquisition; 24h at £19.99 and refunded £35 are near-free substitutes
cases.first_ten: UK plumbers identifiable; products purchased through suppliers already include service
cases.strongest_kill: The paid drawing is subsidised product sales, not an independent software market
cases.cheapest_falsification: No software premium without buyer bypassing free supplier layouts

cases.payer: Irish independent restaurant updating ingredient list and specials
cases.trigger: New dishes and supplier substitutions require allergen matrix and nutritional analysis
cases.money_evidence: Irish Nutricount quotes menu-by-menu outsourced analysis; fixed fee not publicly available, M1 only
cases.bought_outcome: verified recipe ingredient inventory, 14-allergen matrix, current public menu declarations
cases.input_output_and_verification: Supplier specs+recipes -> signed/approved allergen matrix, logged ingredient changes; true recipe substitution not accessible without kitchen
cases.repeated_AI: AI can format provided recipe facts but should not infer allergens from dish name
cases.AI_built_entry: Free FSAI MenuCal handles matrix, ProCafe and Crumb already sell workflow; operator responsible for truthful supplier specs
cases.first_ten: Irish restaurateurs searchable but no separately paying operator identified
cases.strongest_kill: Allergen liability, supplier evidence and free official tool beat a speculative matrix generator
cases.cheapest_falsification: Do not promote; independently locate actual professional invoice for digital-only reporting before counting as commercial spend

cases.payer: UK equipment dealer delivering custom workflow set-up to customer staff
cases.trigger: Equipment/software configuration needs client-specific step-by-step operation document
cases.money_evidence: £55 + VAT per consultant-hour; digital PDF SOP delivered after review
cases.bought_outcome: correct device/version-specific user procedure with screenshots/transactions and supportable caveats
cases.input_output_and_verification: Authorized system/config screenshots+workflow -> reproducible SOP PDF; step screenshots and test scripts partly verifiable
cases.repeated_AI: AI can outline but cannot verify live account settings and equipment behaviour unaided
cases.AI_built_entry: Scribe and built-in tutorial capture already automate routine screen processes
cases.first_ten: Industrial software/equipment resellers; no ten customers outside existing vendor support
cases.strongest_kill: Customer pays consultant who knows equipment and verifies exact steps; no independent sidecar acceptance
cases.cheapest_falsification: Do not substitute generic auto-SOP recorder for hardware expertise

cases.payer: UK joiner/shopfitter ordering outsourced CNC panel cutting and optimisation
cases.trigger: Production cabinet batch needs sheet nesting and machine cutting
cases.money_evidence: ~£480+VAT for 30-sheet board cutting service including labelled physical parts
cases.bought_outcome: cut, edged/labelled physical panels plus nesting utilisation sheet, delivered for fitting
cases.input_output_and_verification: Cut list -> nested cutting plan + quoted parts; digital computation solvable, but boards require industrial saw and physical fulfillment
cases.repeated_AI: Math optimizer already achieves stock sheet placements; generative AI unnecessary
cases.AI_built_entry: CutNest free engine and machinery owners already optimize; independent premium portion is actual cutting
cases.first_ten: Joiners ordering cut services; shops won't buy extra tool to replace physical vendor
cases.strongest_kill: £480 buys material-handling production, not independent £480 nesting calculation

note: Eight distinct company buyer/trigger/outcome cases; source prices are vendor offers, not invoices. #843 lacks public price and is openly INCOMPLETE. Competitor/AI checks do not count separately; #841 banked requires independent QA sample, not a founder effort authorization.
